name: 2010 U.S. Census Mail Return Rates and Demographics by Tract

columns.name: State FIPS Code
columns.description: Numeric 2 digit code defined in US Federal Information Processing Publication 5-2 to identify US States

columns.name: County FIPS Code
columns.description: Numeric 3 digit code defined in US Federal Information Processing Publication 5-2 to identify US Counties

columns.name: Census Tract Code
columns.description: Numeric 6 Character unique code identifier.

columns.name: American FactFinder Geographic Identifer
columns.description: Combined geographic identifier that specifies a single geography (Summary level code + variant code + component code + US + State FIPS + County FIPS + TractCE).

columns.name: Geographic Identifer
columns.description: Combined geographic identifier that specifies a single geography (State FIPS + County FIPS + TractCE).

columns.name: Total Forms Mailed
columns.description: Calculated Total Forms Mailed (Mail Return Count divided by the Mail Return Rate)

columns.description: Percentage of valid census forms returned to U.S. Census Bureau

columns.description: Number of valid census forms returned to the US Census Bureau.
